title: .web-profile.json
description: Per-workspace task profile read by /opt/web/run-web-task.sh (aliased as `web`). The web counterpart of the embedded fleet's .mcu-profile.json: one uniform command surface so an agent never has to guess whether this project uses npm, pnpm, bun, deno or composer.

stack.description: npm | pnpm | yarn | bun | deno | php | mixed

packageManager.description: Command used to install and run scripts.

devPort.description: Port the dev server binds. Publish it with dev-up.sh's DEV_PORTS.

dbUrl.description: Connection string for the migrate/seed tasks.

e2e.description: Browser tests. Playwright uses the system Chromium at /usr/bin/chromium with --no-sandbox.
